sam: i'll queue a fast rerun now (rerun-id 7902). also starting a bisect across the last 8 merges in case it's a regression
alex: thanks. if rerun reproduces, we should bisect asap. if it doesn't, check infra (node load / gpu driver)
maria: assigning owners: @jing to lead bisect, @sam to watch CI runners and logs. @alex you'll coordinate revert if bisect points to runtime change
jing: bisect started: https://ci.redwood.infra/bisect/790 (range commits 2398765000..2398765400). kicking off first trial
sam: watching runner node metrics now — GPU util looks normal but one node had elevated IO bursts around the run window
alex: good call. if bisect narrows to the attention-opt commit i'll prepare a revert PR and notify infra to hold canary rollout
maria: quick notes for follow-up: add a small synthetic test to isolate kv-cache vs attention kernel. reassign oncall if this keeps flapping tonight :thumbsup:
